title: Clerk
qualification: The applicant should possess a Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree, or an equivalent qualification, from a recognised University. The applicant must fulfil the qualification condition as on the closing date of the Online Application Form.
salary: This pay scale has been adopted by the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana for employees working in the Subordinate Courts of Punjab State, recruited/appointed on or after 17 July 2020, as per Punjab Government letter No. HOME-JD-10MISC/54/2023-2JUD1 I/926404/2024 dated 12 September 2024.
age_limit: Age is calculated as on 1 January 2026 .
application_fee: Fee must be paid online and is non-refundable. Applicants opting "Others" in the Gender column will pay the fee applicable to their category as per the table above.
selection_process: Selection involves an online written examination, followed by a qualifying Computer Proficiency Test, and finally checking of original testimonials/interaction, with the final merit list based solely on written exam marks.
